name: kenari
description: kenari provides selected free routes with no initial top-up.
overview: New accounts with zero balance can use :free models. The homepage lists 50 requests per day and 5 per minute without top-up; individual models can have different limits and the dashboard is authoritative. Higher limits require a qualifying top-up or subscription, but neither is required for the basic free tier. Free capacity is best effort.
free_access: Selected :free models; model-specific limits may differ
Higher limits require top-up or subscription
notes: Use https://kenari.id/v1; check the public models endpoint for the current free list.
